_doc: Eval ground-truth. Each entry is { id, query, expected_paths, notes? } — `expected_paths` is the set of source_paths whose chunks are 'relevant'. The harness computes recall@k and MRR over this set. Add new entries as the corpus grows.

queries.notes: Loose-match query against the home-assistant notes subtree.
